text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives a group of Iraqi writers and poets.
- Festivities marking Saddam's 60th birthday continue across the country.
- Saddam receives more congratulations on his birthday anniversary.
- Iraq establishes a web site on the Internet.
- Culture and information minister receives Philippine delegation.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Editorial says Iraq's celebrations of Saddam's birthday are the best message to President Bill Clinton and his administration.
- Article on reinstating democratic practices within the Baath party.
- Article says Saddam's directives led to a boost in agricultural production.
- Turkey accuses Iran of backing its Kurdish rebels of Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK).
- More articles on the meanings and significance of Saddam's birthday.
